title: The Power of Anchors
topic: You're about to make a bad deal. It's called anchoring bias. Someone gives you a price. Your brain grabs onto it. Then you make a decision. Based on that first price. Want to avoid bad deals? Learn more about cognitive biases.

title: Why Doorways Erase Your Thoughts
topic: You walk into a room. You stop. You have absolutely no idea why you came in here. Scientists call it the Doorway Effect. Your brain literally resets when you cross a threshold. In a 2011 study, researchers at the University of Notre Dame had participants carry objects from room to room. People who walked through an actual doorway remembered 20 percent fewer items than those who just crossed a line
